description:
A free drawing app for Windows

AINE Paint is a free drawing application for Windows, designed so that people who have never used
drawing software before can start without getting lost.

It supports pen, pencil and eraser tools with pen pressure, layers, rectangular and lasso selection
with move, scale and rotate, flood fill, a colour picker and an eyedropper, and 50 steps of undo.
Artwork can be saved in its own .ainpaint project format, and exported to PNG with transparency
preserved. PNG and JPEG images can be opened as a starting point.

No advertisements are shown.
